items.reason: First flights to a Spratly artificial-island runway (Fiery Cross, Jan 2016): operating the airfields is a new method; CN201504/CN201403 covered building them, nothing comparable was flown in 2015.

HYSY 981 operating again in the overlapping shelf off the Gulf of Tonkin mouth, as it did there in mid-2015; same-level continuation of state oil activity in the Tonkin/Yinggehai area (CN198201, ongoing through 2015).

Warning, shadowing and protesting US FONOPs continues the 2015 practice of challenging foreign military units near Chinese-held features (CN201501, ongoing through 2016; the Lassen FONOP drew the same response in Oct 2015); more FONOPs to react to is not a frequency move.
Excluding Filipino fishermen from Jackson (Quirino) Atoll extends the coercion of CN201402, which in 2015 was confined to Scarborough Shoal, to a new feature.
HQ-9 surface-to-air missiles on Woody Island are a new capability in the Paracels; the 2015 record (CN197102, CN201002) has no missile deployment.
YJ-62 anti-ship missiles on Woody Island a month after the HQ-9s: the same intensification (missile deployment to Woody), lead ev-13ddf85191.
Radar towers on Cuarteron and other reefs were built over the preceding months as part of the island building of CN201504 (ongoing through 2018); dated only by the imagery report.

Boarding and robbing Vietnamese fishing boats around the Paracels continues the standing expulsion practice of CN200802 (ongoing through 2015); no change of method reported, and the account is Vietnamese-only.
March announcement of a maritime judicial centre is the forerunner of the August SPC interpretation (ev-e30c993d81); one intensification of judicial jurisdiction over claimed waters.

SPC judicial interpretation extending Chinese court jurisdiction to the claimed EEZ/shelf with jail terms for foreign fishers is a new national-level legal instrument; nearest 2015-standing measure is Hainan's provincial board-and-search rules (CN201209).
CCG ramming a detained trawler free from an Indonesian patrol off Natuna is physical interference against Indonesia with nothing comparable in China's 2015 moves (none has dyad CI).
May protest over the Gui Bei Yu 27088 detention asserts the same Natuna fishing-ground claim as the March clash (ev-7ad6eeb7b5).
June CCG dispatch and first explicit claim of overlapping rights off Natuna belong with the 2016 Natuna intensification led by ev-7ad6eeb7b5; the coder may prefer a separate declarative move.
Commissioning the Subi lighthouse repeats the 2015 commissioning of lighthouses on Cuarteron and Johnson South; civil infrastructure on the outposts built under CN201504 (ongoing through 2018).
First military landing on the Fiery Cross strip (17 Apr) is part of the 2016 start of Spratly air operations led by ev-9c7790c4a9; the coder may split military use into its own move.

A CMC vice-chairman's inspection of the Spratly outposts is demonstrative, but whether senior inspections were absent in 2015 is not shown; settle by checking 2015 PLA leadership visits to the Spratlys (if none, novelty; otherwise continuation of CN201504).
Annual summer fishing moratorium, a routine yearly repeat present in 2015 and enforced against foreign boats since CN200202 (ongoing through 2015).
Restating the right of law-enforcement vessels to manage Paracel waters repeats the standing jurisdiction claim of CN201209 (ongoing through 2015); one more reaffirmation.
PLAN Paracels exercise with area closure is one of the regular announced SCS exercises (5-6 a year through 2015, CN201002); called routine and under the annual plan.

Ramming and sinking QNg 90479 near the Paracels is coercive; whether sinking was a change of method against 2015 (when Paracels enforcement was harassment/robbery under CN200802) is unclear; settle by checking 2015 for comparable sinkings (if none, novelty with ev-3a64632f5a's practice as baseline). Vietnamese-sourced.

Government statement of 12 July claiming maritime zones from Nanhai Zhudao and historic rights, and declaring the award void, is a new formal articulation of the claim; nothing comparable in 2015 moves.
White paper and ADIZ-right remark the day after the award are part of the same post-award declarative push led by ev-832c64dcf0.
First landings on the Mischief and Subi runways extend the 2016 start of Spratly air operations (lead ev-9c7790c4a9) to two more outposts.
H-6K bomber over Scarborough and announcement of regular SCS combat air patrols: a new method; 2015 had radio challenges (CN201501) and naval exercises (CN201002) but no announced air combat patrols.
Hardened hangars on Fiery Cross, Subi and Mischief are construction on the outposts, part of CN201504's island building (ongoing through 2018).
Second announced combat air patrol over the Spratlys and Scarborough (6 Aug) is the same practice launched in July (ev-a31de4d44e).
CCG presence at Scarborough continues the constant presence established by CN201205 (ongoing through 2015); denial of reclamation, and more ships is not shown to be a lasting rise.
Joint Sea 2016 was held off Zhanjiang, outside disputed waters, with a non-claimant partner; settle by whether the coder treats exercises in undisputed SCS waters as part of CN201002 — likely reject.

Routine MFA protest naming Vietnam over Spratly Island construction continues the standing practice of publicly criticising rival claimants by name (CN198705, ongoing through 2015); one more statement is not a move.
Routine MFA protest over Vietnamese dredging at Ladd Reef; same standing practice as CN198705, no rise in kind or count shown.

Anti-aircraft guns and CIWS on all seven Spratly outposts are the first weapons emplacements on the artificial islands; CN201504 was construction only. Kept apart from the Woody missiles (different sub-region and standing).

Seizing a US UUV near Subic is coercive but was framed as navigational safety and lies probably outside the nine-dash line; settle by the location against the claim — if not about the claim, reject; if it is, a novelty coercive move with dyad CU.
First scheduled civilian passenger flights to Woody Island, opening the airport to civil use; the flights under CN197801 were official/military, and nothing comparable in 2015.

First announced carrier-group exercise (Liaoning, J-15 flight ops) in the South China Sea; nothing comparable among 2016 candidates, whose exercises were surface drills (ev-436bf217f8) and air patrols (ev-a31de4d44e).
Repeats the Dec 2016 MFA line on the right to arm the Nansha outposts given with ev-11e6c8d7a8; one more reaffirmation, provisional while 2016 is undecided.

Draft Maritime Traffic Safety Law revision letting authorities bar foreign ships and regulate submersibles in claimed waters is a new legal instrument; 2016's legal step (ev-e30c993d81) concerned court jurisdiction over fishing. Only a draft, which the coder may hold back.
Summer moratorium lengthened from 16 May-1 Aug (77 days, ev-85fce8ad11, 2016) to 1 May-16 Aug (108 days) over the same disputed waters: a longer enforced closure, not a routine repeat.

State-backed Paracel cruises have run since CN201306 (2013, ended 2015 in the record) and no 2016 candidate records them; whether a second, larger ship is a frequency rise or continuation needs the 2016 cruise count.

Sansha's announced monitoring stations at Scarborough were disavowed by the MFA as false; settle by whether a disavowed local-government announcement counts as a state claim — if so, novelty (2016 candidate ev-2d721ef662 had China denying construction there).
Completion of hangars, radars and missile shelters on the Big Three continues the island building of CN201504 (ongoing through 2018), begun in 2016 (ev-2318cd96ea).
Fighter rotation to Woody Island continues the fighters reported there in Feb 2016 with ev-13ddf85191; provisional while 2016 is undecided.
CCG stationing at Scarborough continues the 2016 law-enforcement presence (ev-2d721ef662, itself the CN201205 practice); provisional while 2016 is undecided.
Threatening to attack Vietnamese Spratly bases to halt Repsol's drilling is a new coercive method; nothing comparable among 2016 candidates (CN200704's oil-company threats ended 2015).
New shelters, radar and underground storage on Fiery Cross, Mischief and Subi are further construction under CN201504 (ongoing through 2018).
Radio warnings ordering Philippine aircraft away from the Spratly outposts are the practice of CN201501 (ongoing through 2016); 46 warnings in H2 2017 but no 2016 count to compare.
New reclamation at North Island and a dredged harbour at Drummond extend island building to Paracel features; 2016 candidates show construction only in the Spratlys (ev-2318cd96ea, ev-be22ccbe21).
Warning off US FONOPs near Mischief and Triton continues the 2016 response (ev-7cd6864e49) under CN201501 (ongoing through 2016); more FONOPs is not a frequency move.
Flotilla blocking a BFAR ship at the Thitu sandbars extends coercion of Philippine state vessels to a new feature; 2016 candidates had it at Jackson Atoll (ev-5ba80d68d3) and Scarborough only.
Year-end AMTI review: its Spratly part is CN201504 construction, its new element is the North/Tree/Triton reclamation, i.e. the Paracel reclamation led by ev-7f733197fe.
Military transports landing on Mischief and Subi extend military use of the Spratly runways beyond Fiery Cross (2016, ev-66585c9b2f); no 2017 candidate shows military aircraft on the Spratly strips.
Pressure halting Repsol's Red Emperor project repeats the 2017 coercion over Block 136-03 (ev-0934929e97) by the same method in an adjacent block; provisional.
YJ-12B and HQ-9B missiles on Fiery Cross, Subi and Mischief are the first missile deployment to the Spratly outposts; in 2017 the shelters were built but empty (ev-c4bb3394b5, ev-b3a00a44aa).

Jamming equipment on Mischief and Fiery Cross (Apr 2018) is part of the same first weapons deployment to the Spratly outposts led by ev-625213d311; the importer's duplicate flag against ev-ca24d171e0 does not hold (different act).

Largest-ever fleet review was held off Hainan, outside disputed waters, like ev-fdfd60d45e in 2016; settle by whether a display in undisputed SCS waters counts — likely reject; if it counts, compare its scale with the 2017 carrier drill (ev-acb12cf567).

Navy helicopter hovering dangerously over a Philippine resupply boat at Second Thomas is a new method of interference there; no 2017 candidate shows harassment at the shoal (CN201303's presence ended 2015 in the record).
First take-off and landing of H-6K bombers on a SCS island (Woody); 2017 had only fighter rotations there (ev-3560ee4bd1).

CCG boarding Filipino boats and taking catch at Scarborough; fishermen call it routine, implying it continued from 2017 (ev-c7f033d95a, undecided). Settle by whether confiscation already happened in 2017: if yes continuation, if not novelty (coercive).
Surveillance platform on previously untouched Bombay Reef extends installations to a new Paracel feature beyond the 2017 reclamation at North, Tree and Drummond (ev-7f733197fe).
Lanzhou's unsafe approach forcing USS Decatur off course is a change of method from the 2017 identify-and-warn responses (ev-caeb6e9933); CN201501 ended 2016 so cannot be continued.
Weather and environmental stations on Fiery Cross, Subi and Mischief are further facilities on the outposts built under CN201504 (ongoing through 2018), like the 2016 lighthouse (ev-8894d63346).

Militia flotilla of up to 95 vessels at Thitu vs a handful in Aug 2017 (ev-c2627ecb81, undecided); settle by the counterfactual — it answered new Philippine construction at Thitu, so a frequency move only if the scale is a change of approach rather than more to react to.
The Jan-Mar 2019 militia swarm at Thitu is the Dec 2018 deployment (ev-c22227b9dd) carried on at the same level; provisional.

Maritime rescue centre on Fiery Cross follows the 2018 weather stations (ev-73c18aadce) and Subi rescue ship as further civil facilities on the outposts built under CN201504 (ongoing through 2018); the coder may judge a staffed institution a novelty.
Identifying and warning off 2019's US FONOPs continues the 2018 practice (ev-ae29ec2d36) at no higher level; provisional.
Ramming and sinking QNg 90819 at Discovery Reef: no coercion of Vietnamese fishers appears among 2018 candidates, so the method is new again (last seen 2016, ev-694aeef72a). Vietnamese-sourced.

Annual summer moratorium on the same dates as 2017 (ev-62ee135542); no 2018 candidate records the ban though it ran every year — a routine repeat, likely reject as continuation once the 2017 decision is known.
CCG blocking a Second Thomas resupply continues the 2018 harassment of resupply (ev-0c6bdb5f9b) by a similar method; provisional.

CCG attempting to obstruct the Sapura Esperanza rig at Luconia is interference with Malaysian drilling; no 2018 candidate concerns Malaysia (CN201407's Luconia presence ended 2015). Kept apart from the Vietnam drilling standoff (different dyad), though the same cutter Haijing 35111 was involved.

not an assertive act of the claimant — likely reject: a Guangdong fishing boat rammed Gem-Ver 1 and Beijing called it an accident; state direction is not shown. Settle by evidence the vessel was militia.

Haiyang Dizhi 8's coast-guard-escorted survey at Vanguard Bank and harassment of the Hakuryu-5 rig: physical presence in Vietnam's EEZ replaces the 2018 method of diplomatic pressure on Repsol (ev-b73209ee3a).
First anti-ship ballistic missile test into the South China Sea, with a declared danger area; 2018 had bomber landings (ev-5166e52f1d) and a fleet review but no missile firings.

The defence white paper restates the right to deploy defences on the islands, the line given with the 2018 Spratly missiles (ev-625213d311); one more reaffirmation, unless the coder counts a white paper as a new kind.
MFA claim of jurisdiction over Vanguard Bank waters and demand that Vietnam stop drilling is the declarative side of the 2019 Vanguard Bank standoff led by ev-7364114379.
Calling Vietnam's Spratly garrisons occupation of Chinese territory is a routine reaffirmation; no 2018 comparator and no rise in count or kind shown — likely reject.

Note verbale CML/14/2019 to the CLCS restating Nanhai Zhudao sovereignty and historic rights and blocking Malaysia's submission: a UN filing where 2018 candidates had only spokesperson lines; nothing comparable in 2018.
CCG-escorted fishing fleet in Indonesia's Natuna EEZ with a historic-rights claim: no Natuna candidate in 2018, so new again (last seen 2016, ev-7ad6eeb7b5).
The Natuna fleet staying into Jan 2020 is the Dec 2019 incursion (ev-2b5458f8ed) carried over at the same level; provisional.

PLAN corvette training its gun fire-control director on BRP Conrado Yap is a threat of force by a new method; 2019 candidates against the Philippines were militia swarming (ev-218aa0e9a4) and CCG blocking (ev-f0ce0e38a0).
CAS research stations on Fiery Cross and Subi continue the 2019 build-out of civil facilities on the outposts (ev-ed82a89831); provisional.
Note CML/11/2020 repeats the UN-note method of Dec 2019 (ev-d73044394d), answering others' notes (more to react to, not frequency); provisional.
CCG 4301 sinking QNg 90617 near Woody repeats the 2019 sinking near Discovery Reef (ev-73c8829d40) by the same method; provisional.

Escorted Haiyang Dizhi 8 survey shadowing the West Capella on Malaysia's shelf carries the 2019 Vanguard Bank method (ev-7364114379) into a new area; 2019 against Malaysia was a lone cutter near Sapura Esperanza (ev-d9c1d4c518).
Note CML/42/2020 rejecting Vietnam's notes is one more UN note in reply, the method of Dec 2019 (ev-d73044394d); provisional.

Creating Xisha and Nansha districts under Sansha and publishing 80 standard feature names is a new administrative arrangement; nothing comparable among 2019 candidates (Sansha itself is CN201206, 2012).
Tracking and 'expelling' US FONOPs in 2020 continues the 2019 practice (ev-76c553751b) with no change of method shown; provisional.
Annual summer moratorium on the same dates as 2019 (ev-38f5466276); routine yearly repeat.

Confiscating payaos at Scarborough and radio-challenging Philippine aircraft: no 2019 candidate shows either at Scarborough or over the Spratlys, but both are standing practices (ev-3416105bdb 2018, ev-c995d82196 2017); settle by 2019 evidence — absent, the gear seizure is new again (novelty). Not a duplicate of the fishing ban ev-2de6fa208c.

Five further UN notes replying to others' notes continue the Dec 2019 method (ev-d73044394d); by the counterfactual more notes to answer is not a frequency move, though the coder may see the 2020 notes as one.

Paracels island-assault exercise with closure repeats the yearly Paracel drill (2016 ev-436bf217f8; CN201002 ended 2015); no 2019 exercise candidate though drills ran — settle by 2019 exercise record, likely continuation.
Eight J-11s and the first H-6J anti-ship bomber on Woody Island; no 2019 candidate shows aircraft deployments there, so new again against 2019 (last seen 2018, ev-5166e52f1d).
DF-21D/DF-26B firings near the Paracels repeat the 2019 ASBM test (ev-059eac796e); continuation unless the coder reads the second type and impact area as scope.
Restating the right to deploy defences on the Nansha islands repeats the 2019 white-paper line (ev-df2ff8fda9); one more reaffirmation.

Draft Coast Guard Law authorising weapons use and demolition of foreign structures in claimed waters is a new legal instrument with a threat (coercive); nothing comparable among 2019 candidates. Enacted Jan 2021, so the coder may date the move 2021.
